items.text: Artificial Analysis updated six Capability Indexes to v2.0, aligning them with its Intelligence Index v5.0 evaluations.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 将六项能力指数升级至 2.0，并与 Intelligence Index 5.0 的评测对齐。
items.cat_take_en: The revision gives model buyers a fresher comparison layer, but changing methodology weakens direct trend comparisons.
items.cat_take_zh: 新版本提升模型采购的可比性，但评测方法变化也削弱了跨版本趋势比较。

items.text: Pika said its H3 Flex weights enabled a community-built Turbo LoRA that performs two-step draft generation within 24 hours.
items.text_zh: Pika 表示，H3 Flex 权重发布不到一天，社区已构建出支持两步草稿生成的 Turbo LoRA。
items.cat_take_en: Open weights are already turning Pika releases into optimization platforms, shifting value toward community speed.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放权重迅速催生社区优化，Pika 的价值正从模型本身延伸到生态速度。

items.text: Cohere highlighted Model Vault as a sovereign inference platform and said it is adding more open, high-quality models.
items.text_zh: Cohere 强调其主权推理平台 Model Vault，并表示将继续加入更多高质量开放模型。
items.cat_take_en: The move benefits regulated customers needing choice and data control, while increasing pressure on proprietary hosted APIs.
items.cat_take_zh: 此举利好重视数据主权的客户，也会加剧对封闭式托管 API 的竞争压力。

items.text: Cognition offered enterprises more than $100 million in credits to address critical vulnerabilities using Claude Mythos.
items.text_zh: Cognition 宣布向企业提供超过 1 亿美元额度，帮助使用 Claude Mythos 修复关键漏洞。
items.cat_take_en: Credits can accelerate enterprise security adoption, but the offer’s terms and model dependency remain unresolved constraints.
items.cat_take_zh: 额度可能加速企业安全落地，但具体条款与对模型的依赖仍是未解约束。

items.text: Krea released a technical report describing Krea 3’s data, architecture, and training techniques.
items.text_zh: Krea 发布技术报告，披露 Krea 3 使用的数据、架构与训练技术。
items.cat_take_en: The report improves technical transparency for creators and researchers, though reproducibility still depends on undisclosed training details.
items.cat_take_zh: 报告增强了技术透明度，但未披露的训练细节仍限制复现与独立验证。

items.text: Replit integrated Replit Agent into Slack, letting teams delegate projects, connect tools, and receive answers inside channels.
items.text_zh: Replit 将 Agent 接入 Slack，团队可在频道内分派项目、连接工具并获得回答。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding the agent where conversations already happen lowers adoption friction, but also expands the blast radius of permissions.
items.cat_take_zh: 把 Agent 放进日常协作场景降低了使用门槛，却也扩大了权限失误的影响范围。

items.text: Mistral Large 4 joined Open Math OS with 1.05 trillion open-weight parameters and a one-million-token context for approved teams.
items.text_zh: Mistral Large 4 加入 Open Math OS，拥有 1.05 万亿开放权重参数和百万 token 上下文。
items.cat_take_en: The release gives approved researchers unusually broad mathematical capacity, while access restrictions limit its openness in practice.
items.cat_take_zh: 该模型为获批研究团队提供强大数学能力，但准入限制削弱了开放权重的实际普惠性。

items.text: LlamaIndex said OpenDocRouter now offers an API and SDKs for adding document routing to existing applications.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 表示，OpenDocRouter 现提供 API 与 SDK，可接入现有应用实现文档路由。
items.cat_take_en: A simple routing layer can reduce integration work for agent builders, but document quality still controls downstream reliability.
items.cat_take_zh: 轻量路由层可降低 Agent 集成成本，但文档质量仍决定下游结果是否可靠。

items.text: Perplexity said Computer can automate e-commerce operations across Meta advertising, Klaviyo email, and Shopify stores.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 表示，Computer 可在 Meta 广告、Klaviyo 邮件和 Shopify 商店间自动执行电商操作。
items.cat_take_en: Cross-platform execution could save operators time, but commerce agents now need stronger approval and rollback controls.
items.cat_take_zh: 跨平台执行有望节省运营时间，但电商 Agent 更需要审批与回滚机制。

items.text: Vercel launched Security Review in public beta, using Vercel Agent to review vulnerabilities on every push and apply fixes with one click.
items.text_zh: Vercel 开放 Security Review 公测，利用 Vercel Agent 在每次推送时检查漏洞并一键修复。
items.cat_take_en: Continuous review may help small teams catch issues earlier, but one-click fixes risk hiding uncertain security judgments.
items.cat_take_zh: 持续审查能帮助小团队更早发现问题，但一键修复可能掩盖安全判断的不确定性。

items.text: Soniox released STT v6 with agent text input and echo filtering designed for voice-agent interactions.
items.text_zh: Soniox 发布 STT v6，新增面向语音 Agent 的文本输入与回声过滤功能。
items.cat_take_en: Better turn-taking addresses a practical voice-agent failure mode, though real-world gains depend on noisy environments.
items.cat_take_zh: 更好的轮次控制直击语音 Agent 痛点，但真实收益仍取决于复杂噪声环境表现。

items.text: Google Cloud demonstrated building an autonomous multimodal video studio from scratch with its Agent Development Kit.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud 展示了使用 Agent Development Kit 从零构建自主多模态视频工作室。
items.cat_take_en: The demo lowers the barrier to automated video pipelines, but production quality and rights management remain unproven.
items.cat_take_zh: 演示降低了自动化视频流水线门槛，但制作质量与版权管理仍未被证明。

items.text: MongoDB added SessionStore support for Claude Agents through a Claude SDK session adapter that persists conversations and action history.
items.text_zh: MongoDB 为 Claude Agents 增加 SessionStore 支持，通过 SDK 适配器持久化对话与行动历史。
items.cat_take_en: Persistent state makes longer-running agents easier to build, while retained histories increase privacy and deletion obligations.
items.cat_take_zh: 持久状态让长流程 Agent 更易构建，但历史留存也提高了隐私与删除义务。

items.text: Artificial Analysis said its CritPt v2 grading server will become available to the community through its API.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 表示，CritPt v2 评分服务器将通过 API 向社区开放。
items.cat_take_en: Public grading infrastructure can broaden evaluation access, but API-mediated scoring may still centralize benchmark governance.
items.cat_take_zh: 公开评分基础设施扩大了评测参与度，但 API 化评分仍可能集中基准治理权。
